stem.en: The guests ___, the hosts finally sat down to eat what was left of the meal.

why.en: An absolute participle clause can have its own subject: The guests having left, the hosts …
why.uz: Mustaqil sifatdoshli birikmaning oʻz egasi boʻlishi mumkin: «The guests having left, the hosts …».
why.ru: Независимый причастный оборот может иметь своё подлежащее: «The guests having left, the hosts …».

stem.en: The figures look promising. ___, we should not rely on a single study.

why.en: 'Be that as it may' is a fixed formal phrase meaning 'even so' or 'despite that'.
why.uz: «Be that as it may» — shunday boʻlsa ham degan maʼnodagi rasmiy turgʻun ibora.
why.ru: «Be that as it may» — устойчивое официальное выражение: «как бы то ни было».

stem.en: Gone ___ the days when a single salary could support a large family.

why.en: With fronting, the verb agrees with the plural subject 'the days' and comes before it: Gone are the days …
why.uz: Old qismga chiqarilganda feʼl koʻplikdagi «the days» egasiga moslashadi va undan oldin keladi: «Gone are the days …».
why.ru: При вынесении вперёд глагол согласуется с подлежащим во множественном числе «the days» и стоит перед ним: «Gone are the days …».

why.ru: «Were it not for …» — официальная инверсия в условии: «If it were not for …».

why.en: 'Nothing if not + adjective' means 'extremely': he is very persistent indeed.

why.ru: «Nothing if not + прилагательное» значит «чрезвычайно»: он на редкость настойчив.

stem.en:
Whatever its shortcomings as a history, the book succeeds admirably as a story, and readers seldom put it down unfinished.
What is the writer's view of the book?

options.en: It works better as a story than as a history.
It is careful history but hard going as a story.
It is gripping at first, but few readers finish it.
It succeeds equally well as history and as a story.

why.en: The writer concedes 'shortcomings as a history' but says it 'succeeds admirably as a story', and readers 'seldom put it down unfinished'.
why.uz: Muallif kitobning tarix sifatidagi kamchiliklarini tan oladi, lekin hikoya sifatida juda muvaffaqiyatli deydi; oʻquvchilar uni deyarli doim oxirigacha oʻqiydi.
why.ru: Автор признаёт недостатки книги как исторического труда, но хвалит её как повествование, и читатели редко бросают её, не дочитав.

stem.en:
The minutes of the meeting record no objections, which is hardly surprising, since the only person likely to object was absent.
Why were there no objections?

options.en: The likely objector was not present.
Everyone at the meeting strongly supported the plan.
The minutes of the meeting were left incomplete.
Objections were not allowed at that meeting.

why.en: 'Since the only person likely to object was absent' gives the reason.
why.uz: Sabab: eʼtiroz bildirishi mumkin boʻlgan yagona odam yigʻilishda yoʻq edi.
why.ru: Причина: единственного, кто мог возразить, на собрании не было.

stem.en:
Praise from Mr Karimov, a teacher not given to compliments, was rare enough that students remembered it for years.
What does the text imply about Mr Karimov?

options.en: He praised his students every day.
His students quickly forgot his comments.
He had only just started teaching.

why.en: 'Not given to compliments' means he rarely praised anyone, so his praise was memorable.
why.uz: «Not given to compliments» — u kamdan-kam maqtagan, shuning uchun maqtovi esda qolgan.
why.ru: «Not given to compliments» значит, что он редко хвалил, поэтому его похвалу запоминали.
